title: Every point.
Every table.
Live.
hero.text: Umpires score on a tablet at the table. Players, coaches and families follow every match the moment a point is won — at the venue, on a TV, or at home.

steps.title: From the table to every screen

items.title: Tap
items.text: The umpire taps + for each point. Serve, ends and games are tracked for them.

items.title: Live
items.text: The score is on every phone, TV and laptop in the same second — no refreshing.

items.title: Next
items.text: Results go straight into the groups and the bracket, and the next match is called to the free table.

items.title: Tap to score
items.text: A big, clear scoreboard on a tablet at each table, made to be used mid-rally.
points: One tap per point, with undo
Serve, ends and games tracked
Time-outs for both players
Umpire passwords or a tablet per table

items.title: Every table, live
items.text: One board shows every table at once, with the queue of matches up next — on the venue TV and on everyone's phone.
points: Updates the moment a point is won
Free tables shown at a glance
Match queue for what's on next

items.title: Tables assigned for you
items.text: When a table frees up, the next match is called to it. Players know where to go and when.
points: Automatic table assignment
Stronger divisions on your best tables
Two-table team matches kept together

items.title: Groups ranked instantly
items.text: Round-robin standings update the moment each match ends, with every match's game scores one tap away.
points: Standings live as results come in
Match details: every game score, one tap away
Tiebreakers handled automatically

items.title: Brackets fill themselves
items.text: The knockout draw comes from the group results, and winners move on to their next match by themselves.
points: Draw made from the group results

Every result in each player's history

features.title: One system for the whole event

items.title: Singles, doubles and teams
items.text: Team matches with their own order of play, including formats played on two tables at once.

items.title: Players and ratings
items.text: Your players with their ratings, and every match they have played.

items.title: Your club's brand

points: Reset a game or a whole match
